tldr: Mars in Pisces: action is intuitive, compassionate, and indirect.
body: With Mars in Pisces, drive moves through feeling, imagination, service, and spiritual pull. Energy needs meaning and clear boundaries or it disperses.
gift: Inspired action, empathy, creativity, and the courage to serve something larger than ego.
challenge: Avoidance, confusion, martyrdom, and letting anger leak instead of speaking plainly.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
